title: Define battlefield objective and escalation policy
objective: Define battlefield objective and escalation policy; expected: source catalog and world geometry remain authoritative.
acceptance: source catalog and world geometry remain authoritative
The named outcome has actual source/build-bound evidence; unsupported, pending, failed and unperformed checks remain explicit.

decision.objective: Retain defend-courier until the exact accepted current native source-qualified terminal cause admits combat-victory or combat-defeat.
decision.escalation: Accepted player Defend from the committed Escort/current invitation starts only the existing fixed adjacent nonlethal one-Bandit encounter. Unsupported reinforcement and terrain requests are refused with no fallback or partial state.
decision.source_authority: The real registered JourneyHandler, complete model pins/source manifest and exact CurrentObjective mapping remain authoritative. Catalog membership, labels and authored prose are insufficient to authorize an outcome.
decision.world_authority: Use the actual immutable canonical checkpoint locations/positions and existing selected adjacent Greatsword/Bandit admission. Do not derive distance, reach, physics, terrain changes or enemy additions from tactical preferences.
decision.causality: CurrentObjective binds accepted operation/revision/member/actor, source/policy, authored mapping, exact retained cause and single accepted decision; proposal replaces only the admitted objective slot.

consumer_chain: HarborEngine::decide routes the actual journey action
journey::stage_with_supplier records explicit ordered rules draws
actual published CatalogSnapshot selects the compiled JourneyHandler through DispatchRegistry and Engine command entry
actual combat_transition/enemy_tactics qualify canonical adjacent source/world basis
journey finish invokes actual CurrentObjective and retains the accepted causal decision
Session remains sole durable commit/publication owner

existing_source_bindings.source_manifest: model::source_manifest binds the actual ability-check and selected local-journey SRD source declarations; exact digests are retained in pre/post input manifests and native witness output

alternatives.outcome: Use the actual bounded authored Defend/adjacent native encounter and accepted terminal objective mapping.

Future source-approved boss phases/objectives/hazards or reinforcements may be proposed only with approved authored mapping, current rights/pins, executable rule handlers, canonical world basis and registered consumer.
Catalog presence, new action labels, narration or tactical preferences cannot execute novel mechanics or fabricate objective success.

unresolved: General ReinforcementTrigger/CombatPolicyState authoring and approved executable escalation mappings are not supplied by this Design witness.

General MovementOwner reachable-result/world geometry adapter, movement/reach/cover/physics and other positioning remain owner gates; exact current native adjacent cells are the positive bounded basis.
Source-compatible general boss phases/hazards and full standard-rules coverage remain future phases; the selected SRD source subset is not all gameplay support.
Production authentication, physical PostgreSQL acceptance, providers and browser output are not established by native pure consumer tests.

verification.source_authoring_status: New checks UNPERFORMED when this immutable source fixture was authored; actual outcomes live in candidate handoff and guard receipts, not mutable rule data.
verification.required: Complete actual source/dependency/config/generated/toolchain/fixture prefreeze before first meaningful test; native source-bound consumer output and exact test executable hash; complete matching postfreeze; required native and cfg-supported WASM/style matrix.
verification.native: df-tools native gameplay module and real registered consumer are executed by eight battlefield_ cases plus affected retained cases.
verification.wasm: The existing df-tools WASM configuration excludes native gameplay. Its check/Clippy gates cover cfg-supported frontend source only and are not native objective/escalation execution evidence.
verification.evidence_rule: Unsupported, pending, failed, ignored and unperformed checks remain explicit; no auto-completion, paid provider or reconstruction claim.
